hints.title: Prime Factors of Array Product
hints.text: The prime factors of the product of elements are simply the union of the prime factors of each element.

hints.title: Trial Division Factorization
hints.text: Factorize each number by testing candidate divisors from 2 up to sqrt(x).

hints.title: Set Union of Primes
hints.text: Insert all identified prime factors into a collection that retains unique elements and return its size.

hints.title: Prime Factor Set Union Implementation

variables: U: number of distinct prime factors
complexity.notes: Trial division per number takes at most sqrt(1000) steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Multiplying all numbers produces an astronomical integer exceeding standard number formats.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(U) memory stores unique prime factors.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Factorizes elements individually rather than computing the gigantic product.
